title: 2026年人工智能与机器学习智能制造路线图
summary: 本文全面概述了AI/ML在智能制造中的基础、应用和新兴方向，涵盖工业大数据分析、自主系统、数字孪生、机器人、供应链优化等关键领域，并探讨了物理信息AI、生成式AI、语义AI、可解释AI、大语言模型等前沿技术，指出了方法、集成策略和工业应用方面的进展需求。
summary_en: This roadmap provides a comprehensive overview of AI/ML foundations, applications, and emerging directions in smart manufacturing, covering industrial big data analytics, autonomous systems, digital twins, robotics, supply chain optimization, and explores frontiers like physics-informed AI, generative AI, semantic AI, explainable AI, and LLMs, outlining needed advances in methods, integration, and industrial adoption.
